messages:
Alex G: Starting bring-up for the new 'theta' region (us-west3). Need cloud account/project + VNet scaffold, GPU quota (A100 80GB), NAT/GW, peering to prod-hub, and tagging policy. Posting preflight checklist and asking for owners.

Priya S: ack — what's the CIDR plan? want to avoid overlap with corp ranges.

Alex G: planning 172.31.128.0/18 for the region, split into three AZ subnets (one /22 per AZ for worker pools, one /24 for infra, one /23 for services). Keeping management in 172.31.132.0/24.

Alex G: terraform snippet for VPC (staging):
```hcl
module "vpc" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@internal/modules/vpc.git//redwood"
  cidr   = "172.31.128.0/18"
  azs    = ["us-west3-a", "us-west3-b", "us-west3-c"]
}
```

Mateo R: GPU quota check: current A100 quota in us-west3 is 0. We'll need a cloud quota request + vendor confirmation for A100-80g stock. If delayed, fallback to a mix of A10G + g4dn for bursts.

Jin L: I opened the cloud ticket (CT-49302). Request: 40 A100-80g, 200 vCPUs. ETA 48-72h. I'll ping vendor rep for capacity.

net-oncall: runbook ref: <http://intra.redwood/runbooks/region-onboard> — remember to configure route tables so worker subnets use regional NAT and avoid cross-AZ NAT hairpin. Also set MTU 1500 on peering links to prevent fragmentation on jumbo frames.

Priya S: security checklist: add firewall rules to allow 10250/tcp from management CIDR and restrict etcd (2379-2380) to control plane only. Add host-based EDR install in infra subnet user data.

Alex G: validation steps I will run after infra is available:
1) terraform apply in staging -> verify resources
2) bootstrap k8s control plane (kubeadm/custom)
3) smoke test service: curl -sS http://10.2.0.5:8080/health -> expect 'ok'
4) GPU verification: run a small CUDA job and check nvidia-smi + driver compatibility
5) perf smoke: run token throughput test and capture p50/p95 latency

Alex G: smoke command (local tool):
```bash
./bin/gpu-smoke --nodes 3 --image redwood/gpu-smoke:latest --model gpt-small --seq 512
```

Mateo R: rough cost estimate for initial fleet (3 x A100 reserved + 6 x g4dn burst capacity) ~ $18k/mo on 1yr reserved. If we scale to 10 A100s, estimate ~ $55k/mo. Put this in FIN-PRJ ticket for budgeting.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist created: theta-region/2026-03-18/1 (owner: Alex G)

Priya S: handoff notes: once green, tagging policy for billing -> add tags: team:redwood-infra, env:theta, cost-center:ml-prod. I'll own tag enforcement. Also provide route keys for solutions team.

Alex G: I'll update this thread with CT ticket updates and terraform plan when quotas are approved. Planning a 15m maintenance window for peering acceptance (BGP flaps possible).

Jin L: CT-49302 updated: cloud approved 20 A100s and vCPU increase to 500. ETA: 24h for quota to be effective. Vendor replied with partial A100 stock; confirmed delivery timeline for additional GPUs in 2 weeks.

Mateo R: I'll take the capacity tests once quotas land. Coordinating with net-oncall for peering acceptance window. Recommend we reserve one AZ for canary to reduce blast radius.

net-oncall: note — when peering is formed expect transient BGP flaps; schedule during low traffic and monitor route convergence. Also verify we advertise only the region-specific prefixes.

Alex G: next sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. Thanks all :thumbsup:
